pr_title: feat(test runner): support test.setTimeout for the whole block
pr_body:
This enables `test.setTimeout()` outside of the test body, that affects all tests in the block (either file or describe).

Drive-by: fix list reporter regression.

Fixes #7266.

issue_context.title: [Question] test.setTimeout() in test hooks
issue_context.body:
I have an expensive calculation in `beforeAll`.
So, I need to increase the timeout value for this specific test. (playwright default `30000`)
When I used Jest, I just put `jest.setTimeout()` top of the file.

Now, I'm using Playwright Test. And I found `test.setTimeout()` which looks similar to `jest.setTimeout()`.
But, `test.setTimeout()` can only be called inside 1.test or 2.fixture.
I tried 1. but failed because heavy calculation was in `beforeAll` hook.

Do I have to use fixture? How to solve this problem?
comments:
